rooms.1: The throne room of an ancient Persian royal palace: blue pointed arches along the back wall, rich red and purple carpets, an empty golden throne on a dais at the centre, nobody present.
rooms.2: A Persian city of the Arabian Nights: a sunlit street rising to a grand white palace with golden domes and slender minarets, sandstone houses either side, a deep blue sky.
rooms.3: The market square of a Persian city of the Arabian Nights: empty wooden market stalls with striped awnings, white domes and minarets beyond, a sandy square, nobody present.
rooms.4: A narrow street of sandstone houses with arched windows and a wooden door in a Persian city of the Arabian Nights, domes and a minaret rising beyond, nobody present.
rooms.5: A Persian bay in the Arabian Nights: a stone quay running out into a sparkling blue sea, the white domes and a minaret of the city on the shore to the left, the bay itself open and empty, sun high in the sky.
rooms.6: On the deck of a large wooden Arabian sailing ship: the wooden deck planks in perspective, the mast rising at the centre with a great white square sail, rigging lines, a hatch to the cabin, the open sea and empty horizon all around under a blue sky.
rooms.7: A sandy beach on a tropical island: golden sand, gentle surf on the left, a green headland with palm trees and the edge of a dense jungle on the right, nobody present.
rooms.9: Deep inside a dense tropical jungle: tall dark tree trunks, a thick green canopy of round leafy clumps, ferns and undergrowth, dappled light.
rooms.10: Another part of a dense tropical jungle: tall dark trunks, a thick green canopy, a small clearing of grass in front of a mossy rock face.
rooms.11: A damp cave with dripping rock walls and stalactites, and a strange fountain at the centre: a small stone basin from which glowing violet water spouts.
rooms.12: In the crow's-nest high atop a ship's mast: the round wooden rim of the nest in the foreground, rigging lines falling away, and the vast blue ocean and horizon far below.
rooms.13: A small tropical island: a lonely golden beach, one palm tree, the blue sea all around under a bright sun.
rooms.14: A small tropical island: a grass hut with a dark doorway on the beach, palm trees, and a green mountain with a grey peak rising behind.
rooms.15: Inside a grass hut: walls and roof of woven straw and bamboo with rafters meeting overhead, a small square window, an earth floor.
rooms.16: A dark cavern: almost black, rough rock faintly visible at the edges, ominous.
rooms.17: On top of a green mountain on a small island: rocky summit in the foreground, the island's beaches and the blue ocean spread far below.
rooms.18: A small tropical island: two palm trees on golden sand by the blue sea, a patch of disturbed sand where something might be buried.
rooms.19: A rocky grey strand by the sea, with a long stone staircase climbing away from the shore toward a temple; the open sea behind.
rooms.20: Climbing a long, steep stone staircase that rises in perspective toward the sky, worn steps, carved stone edges.
rooms.21: A sacred temple at the top of a long stair: pale marble columns, a high doorway, solemn light, a temple of an ancient goddess.
rooms.22: Inside a sacred temple: white columns either side, a stone altar against the far wall with a golden sun disk above it and two candles.
rooms.23: A hidden stone chamber behind the temple: rough blocks of sandstone, dim light, a bare floor.
rooms.24: A hidden stone chamber deeper in: narrow and dim, rough stone walls, a single torch bracket on the wall.
rooms.25: The inner shrine of a sacred temple: golden walls, pale columns, a red and gold tapestry on the far wall, an open floor.
rooms.27: A musty stone hallway, damp and dim, mossy green floor, the far end bricked with old stone.
rooms.28: A small wooden cabin below deck on a sailing ship: plank walls and ceiling, a round porthole showing the sea, a ladder up to the deck, a lantern, a sea chest. The floor is EMPTY in the middle: no bed, no cot, no bunk, no hammock anywhere.
rooms.29: Lying on a cozy cot in a ship's cabin, looking up: the plank ceiling, a round porthole, a white blanket in the foreground.
rooms.30: A damp grotto: wet dark rock walls with hanging stalactites, puddles, an uneven open floor.
rooms.32: A grassy plain stretching to the horizon under a bright sun, rolling green hills.
rooms.33: At the bottom of a deep pit looking up: sheer dark rock walls rising to a small oval of blue sky far above.
rooms.34: The bottom of a deep pit: rough brown rock walls, dim light from far above, an open earthen floor.
rooms.35: An enormous cave: a vast cavern of rough rock with stalactites, dim light, a sense of great space.
rooms.36: An enormous cave with a magnificent fountain: a golden fountain spraying sparkling water into a wide basin, glowing in the dim cavern.
rooms.37: Death: a scimitar and a grinning skull on dark red, ominous and final, Arabian Nights style.
